titulo.alumno: Superior · Health, evidence and decisions: Listening comprehension

intro: T4 · Advanced · Analyse long texts and formal speeches on everyday topics, travel, health and urban planning; infer logical relations in writing. Topic: Health, evidence and decisions. Focus: Listening comprehension (optional).

palabras.consejo: Practise the word within a sentence and pay attention to the tone.

texto: Listening comprehension of epidemiological reports and medical panels: identify the nuances between firm recommendations and warnings about methodological limitations. When you hear «ผู้เชี่ยวชาญเตือนว่าหลักฐานยังมีข้อจำกัด», detect the speaker's cautious tone, distinguishing promising indications from the absence of conclusive certainty.

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «ข้อมูลเชิงประจักษ์ช่วยให้แพทย์และผู้ป่วยร่วมกันเลือกแนวทางการรักษาที่เหมาะสมที่สุด» express?

opciones.texto: Empirical data allow doctors and patients to agree on the most suitable treatment together.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «ข้อมูลเชิงประจักษ์ช่วยให้แพทย์และผู้ป่วยร่วมกันเลือกแนวทางการรักษาที่เหมาะสมที่สุด» from the text.

opciones.texto: The limitations of the sample in a study may affect how its findings can be applied in general.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another complementary statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Communicating risk information in plain language enables citizens to look after their own health.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.
